description: Source of truth for the development-tools GitHub Release channel. Lists the include globs (grouped by category) and exclude patterns that scripts/buildDevToolsRelease.js resolves into a deterministic, content-addressed toolset. Compiled output (out/**) must be built with `npm run compile` before packaging. Byte-for-byte edits to this file change which files ship and therefore the release content digest. The `version` field is the independent SemVer 2.0 dev-tools version line (devtools-vX.Y.Z), moved separately from the extension's Marketplace version; bump it deliberately when publishing a new dev-tools release.

categories.description: Node CLI tools under scripts/ (risk ledger, release readiness, traceability/requirements audits, etc.) plus their scripts/lib/ helper modules (schemaEnvelope, outputContract, controlPlaneProject, semver, and the vagrant/devtools helpers) and the Windows runtime-matrix PowerShell helpers invoked by runWindowsRuntimeMatrix.js. The scripts/lib/**/*.{js,cjs} globs keep the released CLI dependency closure complete — many scripts/*.js and scripts/*.cjs tools require ./lib/*.js and ./lib/*.cjs at runtime (e.g. buildDevToolsRelease.js -> ./lib/semver.cjs), so shipping the tools without them fails with Cannot find module.

Compiled Model Context Protocol server and its full transitive out/ dependency closure (the server entrypoint requires modules across out/semantic, out/reporting, out/dashboard, out/domain, out/git, out/support, and out/tooling, so shipping only out/mcp + the entrypoint left the pinned server unable to resolve its own imports).
Requirements and traceability documents plus the compiled requirements manifest.
Agent customization surfaces: AGENTS.md and .github skills/prompts/instructions/agents.
